headline: US lifts export ban on Claude Fable 5 with safety strings
body: The brightest day of the period. The US lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. In exchange, Anthropic agreed to pre-release government testing, rapid jailbreak reporting and joint safety standards, and Fable 5 returns globally from July 1 with a new jailbreak classifier. Formal safety commitments strengthen Alignment & Control, while the model's return adds to Capability Velocity. Together that lifts Protector God, a quietly benevolent super-AI, and Gatekeeper, plus Enslaved God, a powerful system kept on a leash. Anthropic also launched Claude Sonnet 5 and a Claude Science research workbench, while Google missed its June target for Gemini 3.5 Pro. Horizon Balance jumped from +1.44 to +2.18.
movers_note: Protector God +0.8, mostly from the lifting of export controls (+0.74) and Claude Science (+0.11), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05) and smaller items (-0.03). Enslaved God +0.7, mostly from the lifting of export controls (+0.62) and Claude Science (+0.13), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05) and smaller items (-0.04). Gatekeeper +0.7, from the lifting of export controls (+0.63) and Claude Science (+0.09), partly offset by Google's missed Gemini 3.5 Pro target (-0.03) and smaller items (-0.03).
